title: Woodland Christmas Clipart PNG Bundle
author: KS Creatives
description:
WOODLAND CHRISTMAS CLIPART BUNDLE – 40 PNG DESIGNS
Bring the magic of an enchanted winter forest to your creative projects with this beautiful Woodland Christmas Clipart Bundle! Featuring whimsical woodland cottages, charming mushroom houses, vintage Christmas lanterns, festive sleighs, botanical details, and cozy woodland-inspired Christmas decorations, this collection is perfect for creating unique holiday designs with a warm cottagecore aesthetic.
Inspired by vintage Christmas illustrations and enchanted woodland heirlooms, this collection combines rich burgundy, deep forest green, warm cream, antique gold, and natural earthy tones for a coordinated, elegant Christmas look.
WHAT’S INCLUDED?
40 unique Woodland Christmas clipart designs
PNG file format
Transparent backgrounds
High-resolution artwork
4000 × 4000 px design size, as specified
300 DPI, as specified
A coordinated woodland Christmas color palette
DESIGN THEMES
Explore a charming collection of Christmas-inspired woodland elements, including:
Enchanted Christmas cottages and snowy mushroom houses
Whimsical woodland homes and miniature greenhouses
Vintage Christmas lanterns and decorative heirlooms
Rustic Christmas sleighs and festive gift arrangements
Woodland birds and cozy forest-inspired details
Botanical Christmas wreaths, pine branches, and winter berries
Antique-inspired Christmas accessories and enchanted forest objects
PERFECT FOR
Use these versatile Christmas PNG illustrations to create:
Christmas sublimation designs
T-shirts, sweatshirts, and holiday apparel
Mugs, tumblers, and drinkware
Christmas greeting cards and invitations
Scrapbooking and junk journals
Gift tags, labels, and printable decorations
Stickers and other craft projects
Wall art and seasonal home décor
Digital design projects and holiday products
WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS BUNDLE
The rich woodland palette, detailed watercolor-inspired artwork, and whimsical cottagecore aesthetic make this collection a lovely choice for designers who want something more distinctive than ordinary Christmas graphics. Each design complements the others, making it easy to create coordinated holiday projects for your shop, handmade gifts, and seasonal crafting.
PLEASE NOTE
This is a digital download; no physical product will be shipped. PNG files are intended for compatible design software and crafting workflows.
Make your next holiday project extra special with this enchanting Woodland Christmas Clipart Bundle!
Download your 40-design collection and bring a little woodland magic to Christmas.
